thread:
zoe: quick thought: what if the Rollouts console had a single "forensics" control that bundles budget, adaptive sampling and a one-click emergency snapshot?
ken: sounds useful. teams keep asking for a way to get 100s of traces during an incident without blowing quota.
maya: we need three primitives: baseline_rate, monthly_budget, and an emergency_snapshot(N) that admins can trigger. show a burn gauge.
zoe: UI: inline pill "Forensics: budgeted" with hover showing current burn and a simulate button. clicking opens a small modal where you can set baseline %, bump_on_burst %, monthly budget, and emergency snapshot size.
ken: backend: sampling decision must be cheap and early. emit header X-Audit-Decision: <id>|sampled=1|rate=0.005|reason=error_class so downstream only captures when needed.
maya: security: default include_payload=false. when true, encrypt with tenant KMS and require approval for retention >7d. emergency snapshot for regulated tenants must be two-approver.
ose-bot: scheduled smoke test: snapshot-burst-1779 at 2024-12-01T02:00:00Z. will post results to #eng-platform. :robot_face:
ken: also want an adaptive hysteresis to avoid thrash: require M failures within T seconds to bump sampling and hold for min_duration. show the hysteresis values in the modal and a small explanation.
maya: costs: display estimated storage $/hr and projected monthly cost given baseline + historical spike patterns. add "apply preset" (conservative / ops / forensic) to choose sane defaults.
zoe: operational flow: when P0 declared, console can auto-apply forensic preset to affected policies for a TTL and notify oncall. include an "undo" button and audit trail of who applied it.
ken: replayable snapshot schema: prompt_hash, kv_keys, model_variant, decision_path, policy_id, trace_id, timestamp. if include_payload=true, store encrypted prompt blob. keep schema compact to save cost.
maya: metrics: audit.sample.requested, audit.sample.accepted, audit.sample.dropped_quota, audit.quota.exhausted, audit.snapshot.triggered. surface these as tiles on policy page.
sec-bot: filing SEC-4901: redaction + retention defaults. default: payload off, retention 7d, emergency_snapshot requires 2 approvers for regulated tenants.
zoe: next steps: ken -> header proto + cheap evaluator, maya -> security checklist, i'll mock the modal and simulate screen and write an RFC. reconvene after ops-bot smoke test. :thumbsup:
